resource_limit: 45 minutes, zero audio inference/API/download, no product/default change

extraction.method: Compile a small harness calling the actual chordDictionary function from frozen source; VAMP_PATH is an isolated directory without chord.dict; preserve duplicate profiles, all 24 weights and labels
extraction.chroma_order: A Bb B C C# D Eb E F F# G Ab, bass then treble

classification.identity: Root pitch class + base quality pitch-class bitmap preserving explicit omissions + bass interval; enharmonic spelling equivalent
classification.omission_rule: Remove only explicit *degree tokens from reference; do not remove extensions or alter roots. This is an availability diagnostic, never a scoring exemption.
classification.same_pitch_set: Theoretical absolute pitch classes including explicit bass. Orthogonal alternate-root flag retained even when same-root quality exists. Never auditory or harmonic-function equivalence.
classification.template_overlay: Compare actual positive treble weight pitch classes with reference base pitch classes under same root, separate from symbolic label availability; not a bass/voicing/acoustic match claim.
classification.historical_scoring: Do not alter A09 scores or treat available root alone as representable full chord

aggregation.per_source: reference seconds, existing wrong-root seconds and their fractions for each exclusive category; orthogonal flags explicitly non-additive
aggregation.cross_source: report GuitarSet and HU33 separately; no unseen-song claims

decision_branches.strict_available_majority: If strict_label_match accounts for >50% of existing wrong-root seconds over all nine and on at least two HU33, reject dictionary expansion as a sufficient general solution; missing patterns remain local limitations.
decision_branches.absent_majority: If candidate_pattern_absent accounts for >50% of existing wrong-root seconds over all nine and on at least two HU33, this supports only designing a separate preregistered dictionary experiment, not adopting it.
decision_branches.otherwise: Mixed evidence: name concrete missing acoustic candidate-ranking evidence; do not launch another subdivision or tune dictionary from these results.
decision_branches.common_rule: Preserve each source including Funk2; no improvement or listening claim from symbolic/template availability.
